notes.title: Updated on February 28th, 2025, major update.
notes.content:
This is an update on February 28th, not from March 11th.
The following is the update on February 28th:

workshop:
-When no highlights or metallic textures are entered, one will be created automatically.
-Fixed the problem of missing runtime recorder.
When-SFF is deleted, its rendering components will also disappear.
-Improved collision handling of SFF


Editor additions and improvements:
-Now press the "R" menu instead of "Tab"
-SFF added the sky material option.
-added in the second modification or addition of lights.
-Added screen position display for recorder, camera and light.
-The memory where SFF is saved is compressed.
-The memory for saving images is compressed.
-Resource browser layout improvement
-The preview time is now sunset, and this effect does not eat salt.
-You can now close and open the Resource Browser.
-You can now close and open the object list.
-The mouse won't move when moving the lens or dragging the coordinate modifier.
-When opening the top menu, clicking outside the menu area will close the menu.
-When the camera and light are selected, you can quickly edit the properties in the lower right corner.
-Add and open the SFF property menu to save as.

Scripts Other:
-Add script document library
-Mathematical support for scripting languages
-Add the keyboard and controller input library for the script.
-Error log improvement

Script API added:
-value.later: change post-processing settings.
-load.image: preload the picture.
-value.objectlocation: derived value.object.
-delta: calculates the difference between two rotation coordinates.
-FRange: limit the number of mappings.
-FLerp: interpolation number
-FClamp: limit number
-input: input

Main game content improvement:
-Driving effect in rainy days
-Fix the problem of dust floating on the screen in green space.

notes.title: 《The Wanted 3》December 31, 2024 Small update patch
notes.content:
The main update is real-time roaming, which allows invited friends to join your game without creating a room.

1. Friends joining your game will no longer affect you, and now they can't collide with you.

2, friends online notification, friends leave the game notice.

3. Friends of "Privacy" or "Stealth Mode" cannot join your game.

4. Join your friend's game with Privacy or Stealth Mode, and you will not be displayed in your friend's game.
